/method/: The archive's own method: how a claim is graded, what counts as a record and what as another person's tree, and how living people are handled.
/sources/: The sources the archive stands on, counted, with which are records and which are other people's family trees. Now also lists the five deep dives.
/searched/: The dated register of every source opened: the outcome (found, null, empty or blocked), what it gave, the control named on each null, and what was not claimed. The Atlas holds only a summary and a service link.
/open-questions/: The open questions, with what would settle each.
/errands/: The errands: what has been asked of other people, and the jobs that need someone standing in a place.
/worklist/: The work list: every task, its state, its owner and since when.
/corrections/: Every claim this archive published and took back, with its cause and its lesson.
/changes/: The working log of the archive, day by day, newest first.
/whats-new/: The pulse: what was read, found and corrected lately (stays in Start as well).
/gallery/: Images and photographs held by the archive.
/coverage/: What each index the archive used actually holds, measured by a control test; the difference between a null result and an empty search. The Atlas holds its own coverage, not this measurement.
/papers/: A worked example of reading evidence rather than skimming it. A deep dive.
/inquest-1902/: A coronial file, read in full. A deep dive.
/finding-arthur/: The search for one private soldier at Pozieres. A deep dive.
/behind-the-paywall/: A marriage never found and four generations called untestable, one subscription away. A deep dive.
/crossread/: Open questions answered from material the site had already published. A deep dive.
/spellings/: The measured table of one name's spellings. The spellings themselves live in the Record Atlas catalogue (left as it is).
